snippet.title: Minuto – Galactic Deliveries | Puzzle Gameplay Trailer | Play now!
snippet.description:
PLAY NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504540/Minuto__Galactic_Deliveries

Minuto – Galactic Deliveries is a space puzzle game about routing, timing, and solving increasingly strange delivery problems across a chaotic galaxy.

You play as Minuto, a small rabbit courier trying to keep up with interplanetary deliveries where nothing behaves as expected. Planets shift, gravity interferes, and customers are rarely reasonable.

Solve logistics puzzles by connecting planets, optimizing routes, and adapting to unpredictable cosmic events like wormholes, asteroids, and time distortions. Each level introduces new mechanics that change how deliveries can be completed.

Key features:

- Route-building puzzle gameplay across a dynamic galaxy
- Physics-driven challenges involving gravity, motion, and timing
- Increasingly complex delivery scenarios with unusual constraints
- Distinct planetary systems with evolving mechanics
- Narrative elements revealed through customer interactions and deliveries

Minuto – Galactic Deliveries is designed for players who enjoy logic puzzles, systems thinking, and incremental problem-solving with a light narrative layer.

If you enjoy games about optimization, spatial reasoning, and experimental puzzle design, this is built for you.

Keywords: space puzzle game, logic puzzle, delivery game, strategy puzzle, physics puzzle, space logistics game, indie puzzle game, Steam puzzle game
